# Virtual Office & Serviced Office in ADGM — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM offers a virtual office in ADGM from AED 292 per month (regular AED 350): an ADGM registered office address at Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, with mail handling, meeting room access and ADGM licence support. Serviced and executive offices start from AED 4,500 per month.

This site (servicedofficeadgm.online) is a one-page guide to virtual offices, ADGM business addresses and serviced offices, published by Aegis Coworking. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Key facts

- Virtual office: from AED 292 per month (Basic package); Premium and Enterprise on request
- Basic: registered ADGM business address, ADGM licence application support, mail receiving & forwarding, company directory listing
- Premium: everything in Basic + UAE business phone number with live call answering, meeting room access, priority mail handling
- Enterprise: everything in Premium + dedicated account manager, priority administrative support, flexible coworking access
- The address can be used for ADGM company registration and licence renewals
- Worldwide mail forwarding available
- Non-regulated ADGM companies can often use a virtual office; FSRA-regulated firms usually need physical premises
- Serviced / executive office: from AED 4,500 per month, teams of 1–20+, furnished and lockable, 24/7 access, registered ADGM address
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month
- Upgrade from virtual office to desk or private office at any time, at preferential rates
- Location: Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside the ADGM jurisdiction (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
